content:
It's that time again when the Apple official certified refurbished product store has a restock, and we're taking another detailed look at some great finds. What we're talking about here isn't those Macs that fell off a truck, got scratched up, and then got flogged off cheap on eBay — these are products that have gone through Apple's "strict refurbishment process," come with the same one-year Apple warranty as brand-new units, and are even more affordable.

AirPods Pro 3 and AirTag 2 won't hit lower prices or all-time lows, but Macs have savings of several hundred dollars and are the cheapest options among current-generation models. Let's take a look at this week's most worthwhile picks right now.

Apple Refurbished Store — This Week's Picks

***Stock of Apple official certified refurbished products may be very limited

Chance — MacBook Pro

My pick this week is Apple's M5 MacBook Pro lineup. On the Apple official certified refurbished store, this series spans a very wide price range — from under US$2,000 to nearly US$9,000 — so there's something for everyone. One of the biggest reasons to pick a MacBook Pro over a MacBook Air is that gorgeous Liquid Retina XDR display you won't want to blink and miss.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, 1TB storage, 16GB memory: US$1,699 (originally US$1,999 for a brand-new unit)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, 2TB storage, 24GB memory: US$2,719 (originally US$3,199 for a brand-new unit)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, 2TB storage, 24GB memory: US$2,969 (originally US$3,499 for a brand-new unit)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, 1TB storage, 48GB memory: US$3,059 (originally US$3,599 for a brand-new unit)
  • 14-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro, 8TB storage, 36GB memory: US$6,029 (originally US$7,099 for a brand-new unit)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro, 8TB storage, 128GB memory: US$8,499 (originally US$9,999 for a brand-new unit)

Zac — Apple Watch SE 3

Looking to buy a new watch? Where's the best price? The cheapest option among Apple's current-generation refurbished Apple Watches: the 40mm GPS Apple Watch SE 3 at US$209.

This refurbished model is US$30 cheaper than the equivalent brand-new unit on Amazon, and US$40 cheaper than a brand-new unit from Apple directly. It will also support watchOS 27, launching this autumn — a solid, affordable way to join the Apple Watch family without worrying about missing out on free updates.

Justin — Apple Watch Series 11

We've always been pretty impressed with the Apple Refurbished Store's pricing — just as Zac mentioned above, you really can find the cheapest Apple Watch SE 3 there right now. But that's not the case for every product, and the latest Apple Watch Series 11 is definitely not one of them.

If anyone's interested, think of this pick as a friendly reminder from 9to5Toys — there are indeed Apple Watch Series 11 deals on the Apple Refurbished Store, but buying a brand-new unit on Amazon right now will save you even more. The 42mm Series 11 is US$339, the 46mm Series 11 is US$369, and Amazon has up to US$100 off brand-new units for both:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from US$299 (originally US$399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 from US$329 (originally US$429)

Ryan — MacBook Neo

If you need a new MacBook, the Neo is the least likely model to be replaced. The MacBook Pro will be getting the M6 later this year, and the MacBook Air is expected to upgrade to M6 in early 2027. But so far, rumours about the next-generation MacBook Neo have been few and far between. If you want the most bang for the least buck, the MacBook Neo at US$599 really can't be beaten. Unless you're a professional with very specific needs, for the vast majority of users the MacBook Neo should serve you perfectly well.

  • MacBook Neo: US$599 (originally US$699)
  • MacBook Neo with Touch ID: US$679 (originally US$799)
